ValidationRule.description: Story Verification Gate: blocks Ready to Promote and Promote and Deploy when the feature branch head (reported by the GitHub push webhook) is not the commit that the last clean verification checked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Verification_Gate), NOT($Setup.Story_Verification_Control__c.Disable_Story_Verification__c), OR( AND(copado__Promote_Change__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_Change__c))), AND(copado__Promote_and_Deploy__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_and_Deploy__c))) ), ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Clean"), NOT(ISBLANK(Branch_Head_SHA__c)), Branch_Head_SHA__c <> Verified_Head_SHA__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The feature branch has changed since the last verification. Run Verify again before Promote.
